nodes.description: External HTTP caller or operator issuing a liveness/readiness probe: curl, a container healthcheck, or an orchestrator probe. The endpoint is unauthenticated, so no bearer key is required.
Single-process ASGI HTTP server bound to settings.host:settings.port. Accepts the probe connection and hands the ASGI HTTP scope to the FastAPI app.
FastAPI ASGI application assembled by create_app; matches the request path to a registered route and serializes the handler result to JSON.
Route handlers for the two health paths: liveliness() returns the literal {"status": "ok"} without reading gateway state, and readiness() asks gateway.ready() before choosing 200 ok or 503 not_ready.
Application-core readiness predicate: true when at least one configured replica's cooldown deadline is at or before the monotonic clock. Reads no transport and opens no connection.
Process-local map of per-replica cooldown deadlines maintained by chat traffic; an absent entry means the replica was never cooled down and is eligible.

links.description: GET /health/liveliness or GET /health/readiness over HTTP; unauthenticated.
ASGI HTTP scope (method, path) delivered to the app.
Route match dispatches /health/liveliness to liveliness() and /health/readiness to readiness().
liveliness() returns the literal payload {"status": "ok"}; the static process check touches no port and no replica state.
HTTP 200 with {"status": "ok"} returned to the caller.
readiness() calls gateway.ready() before building the response.
ready() scans the cooldown deadline of every configured model endpoint.
Cooldown deadlines; endpoints without an entry are eligible.
True when at least one deadline is at or before the current clock value.
HTTP 200 with {"status": "ok"} returned to the caller.
Not-ready branch: JSONResponse 503 {"status": "not_ready"} when ready() is false.
HTTP 503 with {"status": "not_ready"} returned to the caller.
